title: The Mixtape of the quarry
author: Juniper Marchetti
blurb: Sebastian Zhou, a baker's kid who bakes feelings into bread, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
